description: Use when an agent must price, time or route a transaction. Input: optional chain (base default, ethereum, arbitrum, monad, all). Output: JSON base fee, priority tiers (last 20 blocks), suggested maxFeePerGas, block fullness, typical cost of transfer, approve, DEX swap, mint, deploy in gas token (ETH, MON) and USD (Base adds L1 data fee); chain=all adds a compare table and the cheapest chain per action by USD. Example: ?chain=all Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

chain.description: Chain (default base); all = the four compared. Bad value → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: base_gas
title: Gas and fee estimate on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Monad (or all compared): cost per action in gas token and USD
